capabilities: Expand or collapse an entire nested branch with a modifier-click
Fold headings and list items recursively in notes
Fold folders in the file explorer and outline headings
Collapse bookmark groups and nested tags recursively
Run a recursive fold command bound to a hotkey
extras: Relies on parts of Obsidian outside the public API, so updates may temporarily break the modifier-click behavior; embedded notes, hover previews, Canvas cards, and mobile modifier-clicks are unsupported.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's fold arrows toggle a single level. Reaching a heading five levels deep takes five clicks
problem: Obsidian's fold arrows toggle only one level at a time, so expanding or collapsing a deeply nested branch takes many separate clicks.

relations.evidence: Also by me: Better Heading Hierarchy, which draws guide lines that make the nesting of headings visible

summary: Fold or unfold a heading, list item, folder, or tag together with everything nested under it via a modifier-click on the fold arrow.
